His philosophy emphasizes substance over noise, craftsmanship at scale, and the power of patience and compounding in building meaningful technology companies.

---

## Ojaven — Primary Venture

Name: Ojaven
Type: B2B SaaS Platform
Target Market: Modern digital agencies
Core Purpose: Simplifying workflows, client collaboration, and project execution for digital agencies
Status: In Active Development
Planned Launch Date: 10 July 2027
Founder: Ajaypal Singh (sole founder)

### Why Ojaven Exists

Digital agencies juggle fragmented tools for client communication, deliverable tracking, feedback organization, and team bandwidth monitoring. As teams grow, managing the toolchain becomes overhead that competes with creative work. Ojaven aims to bring cohesion to this operational complexity through a streamlined platform built specifically for agency realities.

### Ojaven Architectural Concepts

1. Unified Client Portal — Consolidating communication, feedback, and deliverables in one place
2. Intelligent Scheduling Engine — Understanding team bandwidth and project dependencies
3. Modular Dashboard System — Customizable views for different roles and workflows
